title: Misconception Detector for Processing (Java)
description: Prototype web application for LLM-based detection of programming misconceptions in novice Processing code. A curated misconception catalog is embedded in the model prompt; detected misconceptions are returned with relevant code positions and explanations. Artefact accompanying the DELFI 2026 short paper 'Beyond Syntax Errors: Towards Detecting Conceptual Misconceptions in Student Code with LLMs'.
notes: Funded by the KI-AUX project, supported by the Stiftung Innovation in der Hochschullehre.
